protocol_overview.type: Source-synchronous parallel memory bus. Controller-driven command/address/clock + bidirectional double-data-rate DQ data bus framed by bidirectional differential DQS strobe.
protocol_overview.duplex: half-duplex on DQ (read or write, not both simultaneously); command/address/clock is unidirectional controller → SDRAM

data_strobe: DQS, DQS# (differential, bidirectional; DQSL/DQSU for x16)
data_mask: DM (write data mask; DMU/DML for x16)

protocol_overview.ddr_signaling: Data (DQ) and data-mask (DM) are sampled on both edges of DQS (double data rate). Command/address/control/clock-enable are sampled on the rising edge of CK only (single data rate).
protocol_overview.controller_role: Bus master. Drives CK/CK#, CKE, CS#, ODT, RAS#/CAS#/WE#, BA[2:0], A[15:0], DM, RESET#. Sources DQ + DQS + DM during write; sinks DQ + DQS during read. Implements scheduling (tRCD/tRP/tRAS/tRC/CL/CWL/tWR/tRFC/tREFI/tFAW/tRRD).
protocol_overview.sdram_role: Bus slave. Decodes RAS/CAS/WE/CS at each rising CK edge into one of the commands in the Command Truth Table. Drives DQ + DQS during read; sinks DQ + DQS during write. Generates internal refresh under SELF REFRESH; tracks ODT control via Synchronous / Dynamic / Asynchronous ODT modes.

functional_requirements.text: The DDR3 SDRAM interface shall use differential clock inputs CK / CK#, clock enable CKE, chip select CS#, command inputs RAS# / CAS# / WE#, bank address BA[2:0], address A[0:15] (with A10 = AP and A12 = BC# overloaded), and active-low asynchronous reset RESET#.
Data shall be transferred on DQ pins (x4 / x8 / x16 per device organization) at double data rate (both edges of DQS); DQS / DQS# is bidirectional and differential.
Every DDR3 command shall be defined by the state of CS#, RAS#, CAS#, WE#, and CKE at the rising edge of CK (see Command Truth Table, Table 6).
DDR3 SDRAM shall implement an 8n-prefetch architecture: a single READ or WRITE produces an internal 8n-bit core access that is serialized as 8 DQ words (BL8) or 4 DQ words (BC4) at the pins.
DDR3 SDRAM shall provide 8 internal banks selected by BA[2:0]; each bank has an independent row open/closed state.
Operating modes shall be programmed via four Mode Registers (MR0..MR3) selected by BA[1:0] during a Mode Register Set (MRS) command.
MR0 shall encode Burst Length (A[1:0]), Read Burst Type (A3), CAS Latency (A[6:4] + A2), Test Mode (A7), DLL Reset (A8), Write Recovery (A[11:9]), and Precharge PD DLL (A12).

MR1 shall encode DLL Enable (A0), Output Driver Impedance Control (A1, A5), Rtt_Nom (A2, A6, A9), Additive Latency (A[4:3]), Write Leveling Enable (A7), TDQS Enable (A11), and Qoff Output Buffer Disable (A12).
MR2 shall encode Partial Array Self-Refresh (A[2:0]), CAS Write Latency (A[5:3]), Auto Self-Refresh (A6), Self-Refresh Temperature range (A7), and Dynamic Rtt_WR (A[10:9]).
MR3 shall encode the Multi Purpose Register mode select (A2 = MPR enable, A[1:0] = MPR location).

DDR3 SDRAM shall be initialized by the controller via the defined sequence: VDD/VDDQ ramp with RESET# LOW ≥ 200 µs + CKE LOW; deassert RESET#; wait 500 µs; raise CKE with stable CK; wait tXPR; issue MRS to MR2, MR3, MR1, MR0; issue ZQCL; wait tDLLK and tZQinit; DRAM ready for normal operation.

A10/AP shall encode auto-precharge during READ/WRITE (A10=H → perform autoprecharge after the burst) and one-bank-vs-all-banks during PRECHARGE (A10=L → only the bank addressed by BA[2:0]; A10=H → all banks).
A12/BC# shall encode burst chop on the fly during READ/WRITE (A12=H → BL8; A12=L → BC4) when MR0 A[1:0] = 01 enables BC4/BL8 OTF.
Additive Latency (AL) shall be 0, CL-1, or CL-2 (MR1 A[4:3]). RL = AL + CL; WL = AL + CWL.

DDR3 SDRAM shall accept REFRESH (REF) commands at an average interval tREFI; tRFC(min) shall be honoured between a REF and the next valid command except NOP/DES. Up to 8 REF commands may be postponed or pulled in; maximum interval between two REF commands shall not exceed 9 × tREFI.
SELF REFRESH ENTRY (SRE, CKE=L with CS#=L, RAS#=L, CAS#=L, WE#=H) shall be entered only from All Banks Idle; DRAM shall generate internal refresh and hold CKE LOW; CK may be stopped after tCKSRE.

SELF REFRESH EXIT (SRX) shall be triggered by CKE rising HIGH after stable CK for at least tCKSRX; ODT must remain LOW until tDLLK from a subsequent DLL Reset; ZQCL may be issued after tXS to recalibrate output drivers / ODT.

Write Leveling shall be entered by writing MR1 A7=1; DRAM shall asynchronously sample CK/CK# on the rising edge of DQS/DQS# and feed back the sampled value on DQ bit(s); the controller adjusts the DQS-to-CK delay until a 0→1 transition is observed.

Multi Purpose Register (MPR) mode shall be enabled by writing MR3 A2=1 with all banks precharged and tRP satisfied; subsequent READ/RDA commands shall return the predefined pattern [0,1,0,1,0,1,0,1] on DQ[0] of every byte lane (BL8 fixed order).

ZQ Calibration shall be issued via ZQCL (long, tZQinit after reset or tZQoper after operation) and ZQCS (short, tZQCS, periodic) and must execute against the external 240 Ω ±1% resistor on the ZQ pin while all banks are precharged with tRP met and DQ bus is idle.

RESET# shall be an active-low CMOS rail-to-rail signal; assert RESET# below 0.2 × VDD ≥ 200 µs (power-up) or ≥ 100 ns (during stable power) to force the device into its reset state; CKE shall be held LOW before RESET# deassertion.

configurations.name: Burst length 8 fixed (BL8)
configurations.description: MR0 A[1:0] = 00. Every READ/WRITE is an 8-beat burst on DQ.

configurations.name: Burst chop 4 / burst length 8 on-the-fly
configurations.description: MR0 A[1:0] = 01. A12/BC# during READ/WRITE selects BC4 (A12=L) or BL8 (A12=H).

configurations.name: Burst chop 4 fixed (BC4)
configurations.description: MR0 A[1:0] = 10. Every READ/WRITE is a 4-beat chopped burst.

configurations.name: DLL on (normal operation)
configurations.description: MR1 A0 = 0; DLL provides synchronous DQS/DQ output timing relative to CK.

configurations.name: DLL off (optional low-frequency / test)
configurations.description: MR1 A0 = 1; only CL=6 and CWL=6 supported; tDQSCK becomes vendor-specific and may exceed tCK.

configurations.name: Active Power-Down (APD)
configurations.description: CKE LOW with at least one bank active; tXP to exit; DLL kept enabled.

configurations.name: Precharge Power-Down Fast Exit
configurations.description: CKE LOW with all banks precharged and MR0 A12=1; DLL kept enabled; tXP exit.

configurations.name: Precharge Power-Down Slow Exit
configurations.description: CKE LOW with all banks precharged and MR0 A12=0; DLL frozen; tXPDLL exit.

configurations.name: Self-Refresh Extended Temperature Range
configurations.description: 0–95 °C; possibly doubled refresh rate via SRT bit (MR2 A7) or ASR (MR2 A6).

configurations.name: Write Leveling Mode
configurations.description: MR1 A7=1; DQ becomes feedback path for CK/CK# sampling by DQS.

configurations.name: MPR Read mode
configurations.description: MR3 A2=1; READ returns predefined pattern instead of array data; used for read training.

error_response_conditions: Refresh interval missed (more than 9 × tREFI between successive REF) — cell content may be lost; DRAM does not flag the error.

CK / CK# violates spec (jitter, duty cycle, frequency drift outside speed grade) — timing of DQS/DQ relative to CK becomes unreliable; the controller observes CRC-less data corruption (DDR3 has no on-bus CRC; controllers may add ECC at the system level).
ZQ calibration not executed after Self-Refresh exit or after large temperature / voltage drift — output driver impedance and ODT drift, degrading signal integrity.
Illegal command in current state (e.g., READ to a precharged bank, MRS while banks open) — DRAM behaviour is undefined; the controller must obey the state diagram.
Mode Register Set issued without all banks idle and tRP satisfied — MRS shall not be issued; result is undefined.
ODT asserted during DLL-off mode without disabling RTT_Nom via MR1 — ODT shall be ignored; signal integrity degrades.
Write Leveling failure (no 0→1 transition observed across DQS delay sweep) — the controller must adjust DQ output drive and re-enter WL mode.
compliance_requirements: Power-up: RESET# LOW during VDD ramp; VDD/VDDQ ramp completed within 200 ms; RESET# LOW maintained ≥ 200 µs after stable power; CKE LOW ≥ 10 ns before RESET# deassertion.

After RESET# deassertion: wait 500 µs; bring CK stable; CKE LOW with NOP/DES on command bus; raise CKE HIGH; wait tXPR; issue MRS sequence (MR2, MR3, MR1, MR0 in that order); issue ZQCL; wait tDLLK and tZQinit.
All MRS, REF, ZQCL, ZQCS commands shall be issued only when all banks are idle with tRP satisfied.
tFAW shall be honoured: no more than 4 ACTIVATE commands within any rolling tFAW window (limits peak power on the activate path).
tRRD shall be honoured between successive ACTIVATEs to different banks.
Refresh: average interval ≤ tREFI; up to 8 REF may be postponed or pulled in; before entering Self-Refresh all postponed REF shall be executed.
After Self-Refresh exit, one extra REF command must be issued before re-entering Self-Refresh (covers the timer drift during SR).
ZQ calibration: tZQinit (≥ 512 nCK) for first ZQCL after reset; tZQoper (≥ 256 nCK) for subsequent ZQCL; tZQCS (≥ 64 nCK) for ZQCS.
On-Die Termination: ODT shall be held LOW during DLL-off mode and during Self-Refresh; ODTLon/ODTLoff = AL + CWL − 2 in synchronous ODT mode.
